name: PRO300
description: The PRO300 is Hooga's most popular red light therapy panel — a compact, high-output device built for targeted daily sessions. It delivers 660nm red and 850nm near-infrared wavelengths through 60 dual-chip LEDs , producing an irradiance of over 109 mW/cm² at 6 inches. That's significantly more power than single-chip panels in this size class. At 300W with a compact 12.7" x 8.6" footprint, the PRO300 red light panel is sized for targeted use — face, neck, shoulders, knees, joints, or any area you want to focus on. It fits easily on a desk, countertop, or nightstand, and the built-in adjustable tabletop stand means you can set it up and start a session in seconds. The PRO300 also includes a built-in carrying handle and digital countdown timer for added convenience. Why Dual-Chip LEDs Matter Each of the PRO300's 60 LEDs contains two chips — one emitting 660nm red light and one emitting 850nm near-infrared light. This means every LED delivers both wavelengths simultaneously, giving you a more even and consistent light output across the entire panel surface. Single-chip panels alternate red and NIR LEDs, which creates uneven coverage. Dual-chip eliminates that problem. Who the PRO300 Is For The PRO300 red light therapy panel is a great fit if you want a dedicated device for targeted sessions without committing to a full-body setup. It's commonly chosen by people who use red light therapy as part of their daily wellness, skincare, or post-workout recovery routines. If you're new to red light therapy, the PRO300 is one of the most popular starting points — powerful enough to be effective, compact enough to use anywhere. PRO Series vs. HG Series Hooga offers two panel lines at the 300W size: the PRO300 and the HG300 . The key difference is LED technology. The PRO300 uses dual-chip LEDs delivering 109 mW/cm² at 6 inches, while the HG300 uses single-chip LEDs at 73 mW/cm². The PRO300 also includes a digital countdown timer and built-in carrying handle, making it the better choice if you want higher output and more convenience. Both panels are backed by a 3-year warranty and a 60-day return window starting the day of delivery, plus free shipping (orders over $100). Returns are not free — return shipping is deducted from your refund.
